title: Cursor Router
gist: A classifier runs before each agent request and picks a model from the query, context, task complexity and domain. It was trained on more than 600,000 live requests with a user-satisfaction reward, and the cost of cache misses was included in training. Three modes set the trade-off between cost and capability.
changes: The opposite bet on granularity: route every request and price the cache miss into the decision. It is also the largest disclosed training set for a router, built from the harness owner's own traffic.
caveats: Satisfaction is an inferred proxy and nothing is independently checked. Staff confirmed that switching mid-conversation is intended and that it resets the prefix cache. The named pool has no open-weight models.

bears_on.note: Routing between models is in production at scale, but here the pool is all closed models and the route changes per request.
